actual.planDraftingPolicy: draft full detailed plan before splitting
actual.splitPolicy: no line cap on project plans; split by phase boundary so each phase stays independently executable; root plan stays an index
actual.qualityGateInputs: solution_challenger, system_designer, and senior_qa evidence considered when selected
actual.trackerHandoff: completed phase summary, intent alignment, remaining gaps, and next phase dependencies recorded

actual.blockers: refresh runtime state before the next phase
record post-execution QA verdict (ticket AC vs PR diff) before ticking done

actual.nextAction: fix uncovered AC items and re-verify; do not advance on happy-path green alone
